name: Pilot watch
definition: large-dialled analogue wristwatch in the aviator style, with legible numerals and luminous hands, and none of the defining functions of the other leaves.
notes: Shops list pilot watches as their own category; split from Time-only watch

name: Field watch
definition: plain analogue wristwatch in the military field style, with a clear dial and rugged case, and none of the defining functions of the other leaves.
notes: Shops list field and military watches as their own category; split from Time-only watch

name: Dress watch
definition: slim formal analogue wristwatch made to be worn with suits, with a plain dial and no defining function of the other leaves.
notes: Shops list dress watches as their own category; split from Time-only watch
